info.title: Cocoon Public JWKS Endpoint
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the Cocoon-hosted JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) endpoint (GET https://dashboard.flutter.dev/api/v1/jwks). Used by the partner to fetch Cocoon's active Ed25519 public keys (kid) in order to verify JWT signatures on inbound webhook trigger (POST <partner_webhook_url>) and on-demand status query (GET <partner_status_url>) requests from Cocoon.

get.description: Returns Cocoon's active Ed25519 public keys in RFC 7517 JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) format. Partners must cache the JWKS response in memory and enforce a minimum cooldown period (e.g., 1–5 minutes) between on-demand refreshes triggered by an unknown kid.

200.description: Standard JSON Web Key Set (RFC 7517) containing Cocoon's active Ed25519 public key(s) and kid(s).

JwksResponse.title: JWKS Response
JwksResponse.description: RFC 7517 JSON Web Key Set containing active Ed25519 public keys.

keys.description: List of active Ed25519 JSON Web Keys.

Ed25519Jwk.title: Ed25519 JSON Web Key
Ed25519Jwk.description: RFC 8037 Octet Key Pair (OKP) representation of an Ed25519 public key.

kty.description: Key Type. Must be 'OKP' (Octet Key Pair per RFC 8037).

crv.description: Cryptographic curve used with the key. Must be 'Ed25519'.

use.description: Intended use of the public key ('sig' for signature verification).

alg.description: Algorithm intended for use with the key. Must be 'EdDSA'.

kid.description: Unique Key ID matching the 'kid' header parameter of signed JWTs.

x.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 public key bytes (RFC 8037 Section 2).

ErrorResponse.title: Error Response
ErrorResponse.description: Standard JSON error response body returned on HTTP 4xx and 5xx responses.
